text.en:
Amendment. Section 1 of EO No. 53, as amended, is hereby further
amended to read as follows:
"Section 1. Creation of the Boracay Inter-Agency Task Force.
The Boracay Inter-Agency Task Force ("Task Force") is hereby created, to
be composed of the following:
The Task Force shall be deemed dissolved on 30 June 2022,
unless extended or sooner terminated by the President."

Unaffected provisions. Except as expressly modified by this Order, all
other provisions of EO No. 53, as amended, shall remain in full force and effect.
2

Repeal. All orders, rules and regulations, issuances, or any part thereof
inconsistent with the provisions of this Order, are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.

Effectivity. This Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this 14th
of our Lord, Two Thousand Twenty One.
day of September
By the President:
SALVADOR C. MEDIALDEA
Executive Secretary
